apiEndpoints.description: Map a single statement to CALCRIM elements
Map all statements in a document to CALCRIM elements
Get all CALCRIM mappings for a statement
Get narrative clusters for a case
Delete and rebuild all mappings + clusters for a case
Get full prosecutor theory organization with burden analysis

mappingCapabilities.lexicalMatching: Keyword/alias matching against CALCRIM element keywords and aliases from seed data
mappingCapabilities.phraseMatching: Alias-based phrase detection for alternate element phrasings
mappingCapabilities.confidenceScoring: Deterministic scoring: 70% keyword coverage + 30% classification score
mappingCapabilities.classificationPatterns: 9 classification categories × 3-4 regex patterns each = 32 total patterns
mappingCapabilities.prosecutorTheoryOrganization: Evidence grouped under CALCRIM instruction → element → burden requirement

deterministicConstraints.citationPreservation: Every mapping preserves exact statement text, page, line range, source document

performanceTargets.incrementalRemapping: rebuild-mappings endpoint supports full case remapping
performanceTargets.streamingAnalysis: Statements processed individually — no full-case in-memory requirement
